prompt: Which side of a commercial truck contains the largest and most dangerous blind spot corridor?

options.text: The left side directly adjacent to the driver's exterior side window
The front bumper extending exactly two feet beyond the radiator grill
The right side, extending across three lanes and backwards along trailer
Both sides possess identical symmetrical blind spots of thirty feet

svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 420 180" class="w-full max-h-48 rounded-xl bg-[#1C201D]">
            <!-- Center Commercial Truck -->
            <g transform="translate(160, 40)">
              <!-- Trailer -->
              <rect x="0" y="15" width="85" height="42" rx="4" fill="#94A3B8" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" />

              <rect x="85" y="18" width="35" height="36" rx="5" fill="#3B82F6" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" />
